parameters.prompt: A cute small robot actor, warm orange all over with a cream belly patch, polished and professionally built. Its round ball head has a big dark round screen face, two small round cream ear pods, and a short gold collar joining the head to the body. On top of its dome is a soft mop of dark brown clay curls. Over its screen it wears perfectly circular glasses: two perfect thin round wire-rim circles joined by a small bridge. Its screen shows a thoughtful, earnest, slightly worried look with eyebrows tilted up in the middle. Its body is pear-shaped and bottom-heavy, slightly hunched, on two small round feet. One hand is raised with a finger up as if making a careful point, the other rests on its belly. A small amber warning light on a short antenna pokes up through its curls. Polished, cinematic claymation short film look: smooth saturated matte modeling clay with subtle thumbprints, chunky rounded toy-like forms, soft warm theater lighting with a gentle rim light, shallow depth of field. Standing on a warm wooden theater stage in front of a softly blurred deep red velvet curtain, lit by a soft spotlight. Full body, three-quarter front view, centered and in frame. A single character, no text, no letters, no logos, no brand marks, no badges.
